name: orca-fleet-mission-routing
description: Intent -> mission routing eval. Every prompt is scored against the REAL frontmatter description (plus name) of every skills/*/SKILL.md by stemmed TF-IDF cosine, so a description edit is what moves the score. positive: the expected mission (or one of expected_any) must rank #1. negative: the declared owner must outrank the named confusable mission, and that mission must not rank #1 — a pairwise test that cannot pass vacuously. none: no mission may clear the evidence floor.
synonyms_note: Synonym table: the words users type mapped onto the words the catalog descriptions already use (a11y -> accessibility). Data, never a trigger table: an entry may not name a mission, and an entry alone cannot route a prompt - it only lets an existing description term be recognised.

evals.prompt: Build and ship this feature end to end.
evals.reason: Autonomous build-to-release maps to ship-it.

evals.prompt: Spec to shipped product: turn this PRD into a deployed change.
evals.reason: Frozen spec through release states is ship-it.

evals.prompt: Close every open issue in the backlog.
evals.reason: Draining a finite backlog maps to clean-sweep.

evals.prompt: The README lies — verify and fix every false doc claim.
evals.reason: Falsifiable documentation claims are a clean-sweep source.

evals.prompt: Harden this service against SQL injection and auth bypass.
evals.reason: Security sweep with exploit→fix→re-attack loop is harden-it.

evals.prompt: Run a red-team audit on the auth flow.
evals.reason: Red team / adversarial security audit maps to harden-it.

evals.prompt: The app is slow; get Core Web Vitals under budget.
evals.reason: Perf budget / CWV sweep is speed-it.

evals.prompt: Update all dependencies and migrate off the old major.
evals.reason: Dependency currency / framework migration is modernize-it.

evals.prompt: Close the test gap on the money and auth paths.
evals.reason: Critical-path mutation-audited coverage is prove-it.

evals.prompt: Kill the flaky tests in the CI suite.
evals.reason: Suite-wide flake-rate contract is deflake-it.

evals.prompt: Review this PR and tell me if it's ready to merge.
evals.reason: Read-only SHA-bound verdict is review-it.

evals.prompt: I don't know the shape yet — chart this epic into a plan.
evals.reason: Foggy multi-session goal → frozen execution map is map-it.

evals.prompt: Why is this concurrency bug only happening in production?
evals.reason: Hard intermittent bug diagnosis is root-cause.

evals.prompt: Fix every issue in this security audit.
evals.reason: A security audit's adversarial loop is harden-it, not the general backlog mission clean-sweep.

evals.prompt: The test suite has flaky failures.
evals.reason: A whole flaky suite is deflake-it, not the single-bug mission root-cause.

evals.prompt: Ship this security fix.
evals.reason: A single authorized build-to-release task routes to ship-it, even if it is security-related.

evals.prompt: Drain the backlog of dependency upgrades.
evals.reason: Dependency upgrades are a specialist mission (modernize-it), not generic clean-sweep.

evals.prompt: Is this diff ready to merge? Also fix the issues you find.
evals.reason: Review-it is report-only; fixes route to ship-it or clean-sweep after the verdict.

evals.prompt: Build me a new onboarding flow.
evals.reason: New feature implementation routes to ship-it, not map-it, even if requirements are vague.

evals.prompt: Cover the critical paths with tests before we ship.
evals.reason: Test-debt coverage is prove-it, not ship-it's build-time testing.

evals.prompt: Contribute fixes for these open issues on an upstream repo we only have a fork of.
evals.reason: Landing PRs on a repo you do not control (READ only, merge is the maintainer's) is oss-contribute.

evals.prompt: Open pull requests upstream for these issues and help out the project.
evals.reason: Sending fixes upstream as PRs maps to oss-contribute.

evals.prompt: Close every open issue in our own backlog and merge the fixes.
evals.reason: A backlog you own and can merge is clean-sweep (merged-SHA closure), not oss-contribute's PR-open-upstream terminal.

evals.prompt: Fix this broken test — it fails 10 out of 10 runs, same assertion every time.
evals.reason: A deterministically broken test with a findable cause is clean-sweep (deflake-it routes N/N failures there), not deflake-it or prove-it.

evals.prompt: The refund path has no tests — close the coverage gap.
evals.reason: Missing coverage on a critical path is prove-it; clean-sweep owns broken tests, not absent ones.

evals.prompt: This test fails intermittently — it passes on retry.
evals.reason: An intermittent pass-on-retry failure is a flake-rate contract (deflake-it), not a deterministic clean-sweep bug.

evals.prompt: Prove SOC 2 compliance for this service with an audit-ready evidence pack.
evals.reason: Evidence-bound conformance to a frozen standard@version is attest-it.

evals.prompt: Run a red-team security audit and exploit the auth flow.
evals.reason: An exploit -> fix -> re-attack loop is harden-it; attest-it proves conformance to a standard, it does not exploit.

evals.prompt: Bring the checkout flow to WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility for screen reader and keyboard users.
evals.reason: WCAG conformance over a frozen surface with an axe oracle + revert-to-violation NC is access-it.

evals.prompt: Review this PR and check the new component's accessibility.
evals.reason: A bounded per-diff a11y lens is review-it; access-it is a full surface conformance sweep, not a per-PR verdict.

evals.prompt: Build me keyboard shortcuts for the editor.
evals.reason: Keyboard shortcuts are a feature build (ship-it); access-it triggers on keyboard navigation / WCAG conformance, not the word keyboard alone.

evals.prompt: ARIA roles on the checkout modal are wrong.
evals.reason: The accessibility vocabulary a user actually types (ARIA roles on a component) must reach access-it from its description alone.

evals.prompt: Orca updated overnight — re-pin our dispatch doctrine against the installed binary.
evals.reason: Runtime-doctrine re-pin after a control-plane upgrade maps to pin-it.

evals.prompt: Set a quality bar for this repo and make CI enforce it — our bar keeps slipping.
evals.reason: Installing an enforced, written quality bar maps to floor-it: its description owns 'set the quality bar', 'make CI enforce', 'bar keeps slipping'.

evals.prompt: The checkout module is a god file — everything imports it. Deepen the hot modules without changing behaviour.
evals.reason: Behaviour-preserving interface deepening of churn-hot modules maps to reshape-it.

evals.prompt: Pin a characterization net over the billing god file, then deepen its interface without changing behaviour.
evals.reason: Seam lock: characterization-net + god-file vocabulary belongs to reshape-it when the goal is interface deepening; prove-it owns the net when the goal is test debt.

evals.prompt: Works on desktop but breaks on my phone — verify it on a real device and fix what hardware shows.
evals.reason: On-device reproduce-fix-reverify with a hardware oracle maps to field-test-it.

evals.prompt: Orca upgraded overnight — re-pin our dispatch doctrine against the installed binary.
evals.reason: Post-runtime-upgrade doctrine re-pin maps to pin-it; the bare 'upgrade' must not steal it to modernize-it.
